title: Recallation
description: Mainly adds a Recall potion, but also has Create support + new deco blocks & mechanics!
body:
Recallation ~~is~~ was(?) a simple QoL that mainly focuses on adding a Recall Potion.

It also has Create suppourt that adds new recipes & a few kinetic blocks.
Also suppourts JEI, is reccomended to be used with this mod.

## Features!

- **Endlex Crystal**
  - A new craftable ore that is used for many of the recipes
  - Has an enchant value similar to Bookshelves (Improves enchanting table)
  - Also includes many decorational blocks!
- **Conjurestone**
  - A simple stone replacement that's stronger than base stone.
  - Has many decorative & crafting purpouses
- **Recall Potion**
  - Instantaneous teleportation home!
  - No more keep inventory.
  - Suppourts Aeronautics/Sable beds (at least in testing)
- Runestones
  - A new way to buff yourself instead of carrying stacks of potions!
  - Permanent buffs as long as they remain in your inventory.
  - Is quite expensive, but could be worth the price!
- **_And more to come!_**

<details>
<summary>Runestone Buffs</summary>

### Common
- Waterbreath - Gives water breathing
- Ironskin - Gives resistance II
- Reobsidian - Gives fire resistance & disables Poison
- Nightsee - Gives night vision & has a chance to apply glowing to random mobs
- Medicinal - Gives regeneration II & saturation
- Sprintboost - Gives Speed II & Jump Boost II
### Rare
- Longarms - Increases reach distance by +5
- Hasty - Gives haste IV
- Aetherite - Gives powerful regeneration & resistance when taking damage
- Thorny - Thorns enchantment, but all damage is dealt back
### Epic
- Regenesis - Sets your spawnpoint to your current location when you press your Rune keybind
- Self Destruct - Explode when you press your Rune keybind

</details>


<details>
<summary>Endlex Golem</summary>
To summon an Endlex golem, you must stack up 3 blocks of Smoothed Endlex Crystal Cubes and place a pumkin ontop.
Nearby passive mobs get regeneration, while attacked enemies get increased damage from all sources (both are effects)
The Endlex Golem is also 3 blocks tall, meaning you can block them off from spaces simply by adding a door or slabs.
</details>
